title: Marine biologists discover new plankton off Oregon coast
hook: Marine biologists discover new plankton off Oregon coast

beats.caption: Marine biologists discover new plankton off Oregon coast
If this holds, we redefine marine life.
beats.detail: A discovery off the Oregon coast.
beats.narration: If this holds, we might need to rewrite the textbooks on how marine ecosystems actually function.

beats.caption: Biologists just found a new plankton species.
beats.narration: Marine biologists have officially identified a previously unknown species of plankton swimming off the Oregon coast.

beats.caption: It started with daily Pacific beach walks.
beats.detail: Research conducted at the Oregon Institute.
beats.narration: The discovery came from a routine, morning ritual of collecting samples right at the high tide line.

beats.caption: Nicole Nakata made the breakthrough discovery.
beats.detail: Doctoral student at the Oregon Institute.
beats.narration: It was the work of Nicole Nakata, a doctoral student who spent her mornings studying microscopic life.

beats.caption: They are tiny, brittle star larvae.
beats.detail: Microscopic organisms found in the ocean.
beats.narration: She was specifically looking at brittle star larvae, which are microscopic organisms that drift in the currents.

beats.caption: This changes our understanding of biodiversity.
beats.detail: Every new species adds a puzzle piece.
beats.narration: Identifying new species helps us understand the health and complexity of our ocean environments.
